verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's source is published on GitHub (cockroachdb-gh-1), which superficially satisfies 'read the source', but community evidence indicates the licensing model is restrictive rather than a clean open license — users report needing an annual license key even as free users and enterprise features gated behind licensing (cockroachdb-comm-4, cockroachdb-comm-1, cockroachdb-comm-8). This contradicts a straightforward 'open license' claim. Missing for 10: explicit license text/OSI-approval evidence, confirmation that ALL source (not just visible code) is under a recognized open-source license, and resolution of the license-key requirement contradiction.
